implementation.targetScope: Commands 1.7.2 editing actions, split/join/lift/wrap, marks, command composition and base keymaps. Current and app 1.7.1 controls, Tiptap 2.11.7 callers, packed browser and TypeScript consumers. Browser view, native input handling and app adoption remain separate.

changes: Independent runtime over the VPM model, transform and state; upstream runtime source is not shipped.
Split commands resolve their position after selection deletion; list-wrapper deletion preserves the next paragraph instead of inheriting the deleted code block.
Command capability checks, mark whitespace and inline-atom options, generic-transaction auto-join and platform keymaps retain the public contract.
